# Sourdough Baking

The map. One-liners carry the numbers; route on those, not on filenames.

## The wiki

- [Starter maintenance](wiki/starter-maintenance.md) — a 1:5:5 feed peaks in 6–8 h at 21 °C, 4–5 h at 26 °C; bake within 2 h of peak.
- [Hydration](wiki/hydration.md) — 70 % is the working baseline for 12.5 %-protein white flour; wholemeal drinks a further 5–8 %.
- [Bulk fermentation](wiki/bulk-fermentation.md) — 4.5–5 h at 24 °C to a 50 % rise, with four coil folds at 30-minute intervals through the first 2 h.
- [Shaping and proofing](wiki/shaping-and-proofing.md) — 12–16 h cold retard at 4 °C; the poke test springs back halfway in about 3 seconds.
- [Bake and crust](wiki/bake-and-crust.md) — 250 °C preheat, 20 min lidded, 20–25 min at 230 °C uncovered, pulled at 96–99 °C internal.

## Known gaps

- **Rye and enriched doughs.** Everything here assumes a lean wheat dough. Rye percentages above 20 % ferment on a different clock and are not covered.
- **Gluten-free baking.** No coverage at all — the structural model here is gluten, and none of these numbers transfer.
- **Commercial scale.** Timings are for 1–2 loaf home batches; retarder loads and deck ovens change every temperature here.
- **Altitude above 1,000 m.** Fermentation and oven-spring behaviour both shift and this brain has no numbers for it.
